title: Location staff records carry the same technician value
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Have a valid Public API key for the test organization, the Public API documentation for staff, and a request tool (Postman or any tool that sends requests with that key).
  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member B, enrolled at the test location, with Time Clock on and Technician off.
  • Note the test location's id as the Public API gives it.
custom_steps: 1. Send GET /api/v1/locations/<test location id>/staff with the API key.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The request succeeds.
  • Staff member A's record has "technician": true.
  • Staff member B's record has "technician": false.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11883 (Story 5, Public API - technician value on staff)

  • S5-R1: “Each staff record the Public API returns includes a read-only technician value: true when the person is active, their Technician toggle is on and their Time Clock is on (the same rule as the staff list column, S4-R1), otherwise false. A deactivated person is always false.”

From: Technician Toggle technical implementation plan, 28 Oct 2026, written for PRD version 9 (sources/tech-plan-Technician-Toggle-2026-11-02.md; QA lead 2 Nov 2026: "No newer plan; go ahead"); quoted only where it still matches PRD version 17, read 2 Nov 2026

  • Tech plan: “| `GET /api/v1/staff`, `/v1/staff/{id}`, `/v1/locations/{id}/staff` | `technician: boolean` (readOnly); not in `StaffUpdate`; `PATCH` ignores it | B4 |”
